text: Healthy living means taking care of your body and mind. First, eat a balanced diet with plenty of fruit, vegetables, and whole grains, and avoid too much sugar or fast food. Second, exercise regularly—even a thirty-minute walk each day makes a big difference. Getting enough sleep is also important, so try to rest for seven to eight hours every night. Don't forget your mental health: talk to friends, take breaks, and spend time on hobbies you enjoy. Finally, keep a good work-life balance by not working too much and making time to relax. Small daily habits like these can help you feel happier and healthier.
